note: Curated, human-reviewed allowlist of Nuclei template IDs Diana trusts as evidence (Security Phase 7.4). Every template is a real, pinned YAML file committed in diana/security/nuclei/templates/ -- never fetched from Nuclei's community template registry at scan time (the same 'pinned, committed ruleset, never a live external registry' principle diana/security/verifiers/semgrep-rules.yml and gitleaks-config.toml already follow). template_digest is the sha256 of that committed file's exact bytes, recomputed and checked at collection time -- a PR cannot add or alter a template file and have that same PR's evidence trusted against it, since this file and the templates it references both live in the protected base.
